name: fxUSD
oneLiner: fxUSD is f(x) Protocol's CDP-minted dollar overcollateralized by WBTC and wstETH, with a Stability Pool arbitraging Curve to defend the peg.
collateral: WBTC (majority) and wstETH deposited as collateral into f(x) Protocol CDP vaults; xPOSITIONs represent looped leveraged positions as NFTs; fully overcollateralized; WBTC custody by BitGo/Coinbase introduces centralized dependency
pegMechanism: CDP-style with overcollateralization and liquidations; f(x) Protocol Stability Pool arbitrages the USDC/fxUSD Curve pool to defend the peg; two yield strategies: (1) Curve LP with FXN gauge, (2) Stability Pool with wstETH real yield, fxSAVE autocompound, or FXN gauge; fxUSD redeemable at oracle price for underlying collateral when below peg; automatic rebalancing and liquidation of under-collateralized positions

oracleRisk.summary: f(x) V2 combines Chainlink, DEX spot, and anchor feeds for ETH/WBTC pricing and falls back to anchor pricing when governed deviation thresholds are breached.

branchApplicability.rationale: f(x) deploys separate WBTC and wstETH long pools with collateral-specific price oracles, debt-ratio parameters, and position accounting. Both pools share the PoolManager, fxUSD/USDC base-pool liquidation funding, and reserve-pool shortfall path, so each collateral pool is reviewed separately.

branches.label: WBTC long-pool collateral branch
branches.summary: The WBTC long pool prices WBTC from a Chainlink BTC/USD anchor and configured on-chain spot paths, with a 1% deviation clamp to the anchor.

feeds.provider: f(x) WBTCPriceOracle using Chainlink BTC/USD and configured on-chain spot sources
feeds.path: Chainlink BTC/USD anchor plus DEX spot encodings -> WBTCPriceOracle minimum liquidation price -> WBTC long-pool debt ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: The oracle includes its Chainlink-derived anchor with on-chain spot paths and replaces an outlying minimum or maximum with the anchor when deviation exceeds the governed threshold (initialized to 1%). A stale or non-positive Chainlink answer reverts rather than using a cached last-good price.

collateralParameters.note: Published Ethereum deployment parameters set rebalancing at an 88% debt ratio and liquidation at a 95% debt ratio, with collateral-specific capacity and fee settings.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Once a WBTC pool tick reaches the liquidation debt ratio, callers can invoke the fxUSD base pool to supply fxUSD or USDC; the PoolManager consumes that liquidity, cancels pool debt, and transfers priced WBTC plus the configured bonus.
branches.backstop: The fxUSD/USDC base pool supplies liquidation liquidity and the collateral-specific ReservePool balance can cover liquidation bonus or shortfall before socialization.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: If collateral plus reserve funds cannot cover a tick's debt, the pool removes the exhausted collateral and redistributes remaining bad debt through the pool debt index. Oracle failure reverts price-dependent liquidation, and the PoolManager pause blocks liquidation calls; the reviewed sources do not define a separate global shutdown settlement.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified Base FxUSD OFT implementation exposes owner-controlled pause() and unpause() functions alongside transfer and transferFrom, so the tracked fxUSD deployment has direct system-wide transfer-pause capability. The official f(x) risk documentation describes protocol halts during peg stress, while the Ethereum deployment is separately upgradeable through the reviewed timelock. USDC, Aave, and collateral dependencies add separate upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG-1 Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: The current live reserve capture observed on 2026-07-14 contains WBTC and wstETH collateral only, at 85.8% and 14.2% respectively. f(x) documentation identifies separate WBTC and wstETH long pools and their liquidation paths; the weights are a point-in-time live capture rather than a permanent allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current f(x) live collateral capture with official pool documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live capture identifies collateral categories and weights but does not establish the current custody split among WBTC custodians or the operational liquidity available for each pool.

mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum fxUSD is minted CDP-style against protocol collateral and its proxy upgrades flow through a 3-day timelock to a 6-of-9 Safe. The immutable Base LayerZero OFT mints only from authenticated bridge messages; a separate 3-of-4 Safe controls its peer and messaging configuration.

upgradeability.controlRef: fxUSD deployment-wide upgrade and configuration authorities

controls.label: fxUSD deployment-wide upgrade and configuration authorities
bypassSurfaces: Ethereum proxy replacement requires the 3-day TimelockController path; Base OFT bytecode is immutable.
The Base 3-of-4 Safe can immediately change OFT peers and LayerZero messaging configuration, which can change the authenticated cross-chain mint path without replacing token bytecode.
controls.evidence: Ethereum remains upgradeable through ProxyAdmin 0x9b54... and TimelockController 0x6886... with a 259,200-second delay. At Base block 48,621,538, fxUSD OFT 0x55380... had a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot and owner() = Safe 0x44e415.... The Safe is v1.3.0 with threshold 3, four owners, no enabled modules, and singleton 0xfb1bffc9.... The aggregate delay is zero because the Base Safe can immediately reconfigure peers and messaging security even though it cannot replace the OFT bytecode.

controls.label: fxUSD Base OFT owner (3-of-4 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Base block 48,621,538, owner() on the immutable fxUSD OFT returned this Safe. On-chain calls returned VERSION 1.3.0, threshold 3, four owners, no enabled modules, and singleton 0xfb1bffc9.... LayerZero's OFT model gives the owner control of peers and enforced options, so this Safe can authorize which authenticated bridge messages reach the Base mint path.

controls.label: fxUSD token proxy (EIP-1967, OZ TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.capDescription: fxUSD is minted only against overcollateralized wstETH/WBTC CDP positions inside f(x) Protocol; supply expands and contracts with collateral and redemptions, not by an off-protocol issuer minter.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,294,712, EIP-1967 slots confirmed: implementation = 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1, proxy admin = 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 (OZ ProxyAdmin).

controls.label: f(x) Protocol OZ TimelockController (3-day delay)
controls.evidence: ProxyAdmin owner = 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a (OZ TimelockController, minDelay = 259200s / 3 days). PROPOSER/EXECUTOR/CANCELLER/TIMELOCK_ADMIN = 0x26B2ec4E02ebe2F54583af25b647b1D619e67BbF (6-of-9 Safe). Additional TIMELOCK_ADMIN = 0xa1d0027Ca4C0CB79f9403d06A29470abC7b0a468 (EOA, no code).

controls.label: f(x) Protocol governance multisig (6-of-9 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: Safe API confirmed 6-of-9 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 at block 25,294,712; no modules, no guard. Holds all timelock roles (PROPOSER, EXECUTOR, CANCELLER, TIMELOCK_ADMIN). A bare EOA (0xa1d0027…) also holds TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE but not PROPOSER/EXECUTOR.

review.evidence: Ethereum fxUSD proxy admin 0x9b54... is owned by TimelockController 0x6886... with a 3-day delay and a 6-of-9 proposer/executor Safe. The AladdinDAO deployment registry and Base RPC identify the second tracked deployment as an immutable LayerZero OFT. At Base block 48,621,538, owner() returned a 3-of-4 Safe with no enabled modules; that Safe controls the OFT peer and messaging configuration. Both tracked deployments and their distinct code/configuration authorities are now reviewed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: fxUSD crosses from its Ethereum home chain to Base via a LayerZero V2 OFT Adapter: the FxUSDOFTAdaptor lockbox (0xA07d8cc4...) locks canonical fxUSD ERC-20 on Ethereum while the Base deployment is a native LayerZero OFT that mints/burns 1:1. The durable cross-chain supply path is thus an external lock/mint bridge with a LayerZero control surface.
